We are looking for a highly proficient Java Developer who is passionate about clean code and eager to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) to real-world Master Data Management (MDM) challenges. You will join our core team to build high-volume, low-latency applications that power our AI-based software suite. This role is perfect for a strong Java engineer who wants to transition into the AI space by integrating machine learning models into enterprise-grade systems.
Key Responsibilities
Core Development: Design and develop Java applications using the Spring Framework (Boot, MVC, Data), focusing on high-performance backend logic.
AI Implementation: Work alongside data scientists to integrate AI/ML components (like classification and matching algorithms) into our Java-based product suite.
Scalable Systems: Build and maintain Microservices and RESTful web services that handle large-scale enterprise data for Fortune 500 companies.
Performance Tuning: Use multithreading and concurrency techniques to ensure our AI processing tasks run efficiently and without bottlenecks.
Data Management: Utilize Hibernate for database interaction and ORM, ensuring data integrity across complex MDM workflows.
UI/UX Integration: Enhance web interfaces using JSP, jQuery, and AJAX to present AI-driven data insights to users.
Full SDLC: Participate in the entire software lifecycle, from initial requirements and coding to testing and deployment on JBoss .
Technical Requirements
The Java Core: * 3+ years of professional experience in Java and the Spring Framework .
Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and design patterns.
Hands-on experience with Multithreading and Concurrency .
Proficiency in SQL and Hibernate/JPA .
The AI Focus:
A fundamental understanding of AI/ML concepts (e.g., how models are trained and used).
Interest or basic experience with AI libraries/platforms (e.g., TensorFlow, Scikit-learn , or using AI APIs).
Ability to write Java code that interacts seamlessly with Python-based AI models.
Tools & Environment:
Experience with Microservices architecture.
Familiarity with JBoss or similar application servers.
Experience with version control (SVN is a plus).
Who You Are
You are "Best in Class" when it comes to Java you write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
You are curious about AI and want to see how it solves business problems like data classification and governance.
You enjoy troubleshooting complex issues and optimizing application performance.
You have a bachelor s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Location: Remote
Type: Full Time


Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced MLOps Engineer to build, deploy, monitor, and scale machine learning models in production. This role works closely with Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, and Product teams to ensure reliable and secure ML systems.

Monitor model performance, data drift, and system reliability

Collaborate with Data Science teams to productionize models

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, or DevOps with ML systems
Strong experience with Python
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure)
Knowledge of ML lifecycle management tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, etc.)
Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)
Understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting systems
Strong understanding of model deployment, scaling, and performance monitoring
Experience with container orchestrators for deployment, such as AWS ECS/EKS
Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Elasticsearch
Good to Have
Experience with data pipelines (Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
Knowledge of feature stores and data versioning tools
Exposure to AI/ML applications in production environments
Experience working with large datasets and real-time inference
Familiarity with data lakes (S3,Glue,Iceberg, Athena/Spark)

Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain high-performance and scalable backend applications using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Design, implement, and optimize RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs for efficient data exchange and integration.
Proactively monitor and enhance application performance through optimizations and continuous improvements.
Translate complex business requirements into clean, maintainable, and efficient backend code.
Collaborate with frontend and full-stack teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless full-stack functionality.
Leverage AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes for scalable deployment, and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
Work with version control tools like Git and GitHub to manage codebase and ensure smooth collaboration within the development team.
Lead the integration of AI agents and AI models into backend systems to enable automation and intelligent decision-making.


Technical Skills:

Experience with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB for backend development.
Experience designing and managing RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs.
Proficiency in deploying and scaling applications using AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and managing CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with integrating AI models and AI agents into backend systems.
Knowledge of Git and GitHub for version control and code collaboration.
Understanding of database design, query optimization, and working with high-performance data systems.

About the role

You will build the whole product, not a slice of it: the interface, the API, the data layer and the AI services that sit underneath. Our work is AI that has to survive real users, so you will care as much about the rollback path and the p95 latency as about the feature itself. You will own features from a first scope through to production and the on-call that comes with it.

What you will do
Build and ship full-stack features for AI products, with a React or Next front end and a Python or Node service behind it.
Integrate LLMs, retrieval pipelines and third-party APIs into clean, observable services that hold up under load.
Model the data, design the schema and wire the vector and relational stores the AI reads from.
Instrument what you ship: logging, tracing and the dashboards that tell you when something is drifting in production.
Own the deployment path, including CI, environment config, rollbacks and the cost and latency budgets for your service.
Review code, write the tests that matter, and keep the shared stack small and consistent across pods.
What we are looking for
3 to 6 years building and shipping web applications, with real production ownership rather than only feature tickets.
Strong JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Next, and a backend language you are fluent in, ideally Python or Node.
Solid grasp of relational databases and API design, plus the basics of containers and one major cloud.
Hands-on experience wiring an LLM or external API into a product, including the error handling that keeps it standing.
A production mindset: you reach for the eval, the rollback and the metric before you reach for the demo.
Nice to have
Experience with FastAPI, pgvector or a managed vector database, and a queue or streaming system.
Familiarity with RAG patterns and agent frameworks such as LangGraph.
Comfort with infrastructure as code and observability tooling.
What we offer
Whole-product ownership, so you ship features instead of fragments.
A modern, deliberately small stack shared across pods, with senior engineers to learn from.
AI work that reaches production, measured against the five numbers in the Production-First method.
A hybrid seat at our Noida delivery center, with a team that has built in-house since 2017.
